PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$40.00) SERVED SEP-29-2022, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT CHAVEZ, REGINA

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-30-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-30-2022 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF FREDRICK EDWARDS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT REGINA CHAVEZ IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-30-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF EDWARDS, FREDRICK IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT CHAVEZ, REGINA INSUFFICENT EVIDENCE PLAINTIFF LOANED MOVING COSTS TO DEFENDANT. CASE IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
